title: Deep linking
description: Scheme and universal-link helpers that map incoming URLs and notification payloads to Expo Router navigations.

env.EXPO_PUBLIC_DEEP_LINK_HOST: Optional HTTPS host for universal / app links (e.g. app.example.com)

notes: Configure EXPO_PUBLIC_DEEP_LINK_HOST and extend app.config intent filters for production universal links.
Push notification payloads may include a `deeplink` string path consumed by DeepLinkProvider.
